description: Pierre Damoy's 2014 Marsannay La Bretignière is a poised Côte de Nuits Pinot Noir with dark cherry fruit, subtle spice, and a firm mineral line. Bottle age has softened the structure while preserving a distinctly savory center.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2014 Domaine Pierre Damoy Marsannay La Bretignière.
palate: Layered fruit, fine tannin, mineral tension
sommelierNotes: Serve at cellar temperature after a brief decant for sediment; pair with duck, veal, or lentils with smoked bacon.
